import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def run(name,f,p0):
    best=None
    for s in range(8):
        p=np.random.RandomState(s).normal(size=len(p0))*np.array(p0)
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda q: f(q)-dP_dt, p, max_nfev=5000)
            if np.all(np.isfinite(r.fun)) and (best is None or r.cost<best.cost): best=r
        except Exception as e: pass
    print(name, 'NMSE', np.mean((f(best.x)-dP_dt)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), np.round(best.x,4))
